description: Who this connection acts as: the key owner's `userId` (uid), `userName` and current `role` in the workspace (the role the console would apply to the same action), the `scopes` the credential carries, the workspace (`companyId`, `companyName`) and its entity vocabulary. Use `userId` as the "me" in assigneeUid, mentions and similar fields; to find a teammate's uid use anyforge_list_members. `userId`, `userName` and `role` are null for a key with no owner. Read-only; any valid credential may call it.
name: anyforge_whoami
title: Whoami
